n: Interactive and Safe AI for KS2 upwards (Computing at School blog)
t: A blog describing an offline workshop where students train image classifiers on Raspberry Pi kits.
steps: Find the Computing at School blog post.
Read the full description of both halves.
Ask IT whether the school can build the kits.
Prepare Raspberry Pi 4 kits with USB cameras.
Prepare locked-down tablets and a portable Wi-Fi hotspot.
Moderate about 2,000 pre-generated images in advance.
Delete all training images and models at the end of the session.
